title: TSMC board approves up to $500M investment in Anthropic IPO shares

sources.quote: In an official statement, TSMC said its board approved an investment of up to $500 million in Anthropic to acquire its common shares at the company’s per-share initial public offering price.

explain: TSMC's board approved spending up to $500 million to buy Anthropic common shares at the per-share price of Anthropic's planned IPO. The amount is a cap, not a confirmed purchase.
